tax.text: Castillo calls for cutting taxes, including on income, fuel and estates, and lowering the corporate rate.
tax.quote: Reduce taxes on income, fuel, death. Allow people to get paid on merit, not just because of the color of their skin or race.

trade.text: Castillo wants to bring manufacturing jobs back to the U.S. and eliminate the trade deficit with other countries.
trade.quote: balance the trade so that there's no deficit between U.S. and foreign countries

schools.text: She says she supports school choice for poor families.
schools.quote: I am the Only Candidate who supports school choice for poor families.

safety.text: Castillo describes herself as a supporter of law enforcement over criminals.
safety.quote: I am the Only Candidate who supports law enforcement over criminals

immigration.text: Castillo calls for closing the border and reinstating the 'Remain in Mexico' policy.
immigration.quote: First and foremost, close the border. Second, implement the Stay in Mexico order once again.

guns.text: Castillo, a lifetime NRA member, opposes restricting law-abiding gun owners for others' wrongdoing.
guns.quote: The law abiding citizen should not be restricted because of the fault of others.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Castillo states that a boy is a boy and a girl is a girl and supports protecting women's sports.
gender.quote: A Boy is a Boy, A Girl is a Girl.

health.text: Castillo opposes universal health care and would limit Medicare to those who paid into it.
health.quote: Medicare should be available only for the people that paid into it.

energy.text: Castillo downplays human impact on climate and would reinstate oil pipelines and offshore drilling.
energy.quote: Climate change is a natural phenomenon, our impact is not that drastic.

voting.text: Castillo advocates voter ID laws and warns against undocumented immigrants being able to vote.
voting.quote: For 248 years the law of the land has been, only a citizen born, or naturalized is allowed to vote.
